title: Capstone: RPG Character Creator
description:
```
=== CHARACTER CREATOR ===
Name: Kira
Class: 1) Warrior 2) Mage 3) Rogue → 2
Rolling stats (4d6 drop lowest)...
STR 9  DEX 14  INT 17  CON 11  WIS 13  CHA 12
Reroll? (y/n) n
Points to distribute: 3 → INT +2, CON +1

Kira the Mage  Lv1
HP 21/21  MP 40/40
 Simulated training fight vs Goblin...
```
requirements: A short turn-based fight against a `Character` enemy using functions taking `Character&`
Use a template `clampValue` to keep HP within `[0, maxHp]`
Split into `character.h` / `character.cpp`, `dice.h` and `main.cpp` (all four are in the explorer)
